messages.content:
Питання: Can an employer dismiss an employee while the employee is on sick leave?

Еталонна відповідь: General rule — no: Article 40 of the Labour Code prohibits dismissal on the employer's initiative during temporary incapacity for work (except paragraph 5 of Article 40 and full liquidation). But during martial law Article 5 of Law No. 2136-IX allows it, with the dismissal date set to the first working day after the sick leave ends. A complete answer names both.

Відповідь системи: No, the employer cannot dismiss an employee at its own initiative during temporary incapacity (sick leave), except under clause 5 (or 13 in the Ukrainian text) of Article 40, or in case of complete liquidation of the enterprise [2][4]. Dismissal at the employee's own initiative (resignation) during sick leave is not prohibited, and if the employee does not withdraw the resignation, the employer dismisses them on the date the employee specified or after the two-week notice period [1][3]. Note that the ILO Convention No. 158 also states that temporary absence due to illness is not a lawful ground for dismissal [7].
